content.thinking:
MaskGroup expects domain per pattern list/tuple of intervals per coord. `full_domains` returns tuple of coordinate `(lo,hi)` pairs; at domain[pos] `(lo,hi)` iterating yields lo,hi ints? Wait full_domains:
```
return [tuple((int(lo),int(hi)) for lo,hi in pattern) for pattern in patterns]
```
Each domain=((lo0,hi0),(lo1,hi1),...). domain[pos]=(lo,hi), iterating `for lo,hi in domain[pos]` tries ints. Need standard domains representation per coord: tuple of intervals. So full_domains should return `[tuple(((int(lo),int(hi)),) for ...)]` i.e. each coord `((lo,hi),)`. exact already returns tuple(parts) where parts tuple intervals. Fix full_domains.
